positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for a suite of Enterprise Resource Planning applications around manufacturing planning and production ranging from complex single page application forms to large scheduled tasks driving production decisions. Development spanned the full stack, including data model design.

• Technical lead for teams ranging in size from 4 to 7 engineers. Responsibilities included providing product architecture guidance, task definition for engineers, backlog grooming, as well as interfacing with customers to determine their needs.

• Led large projects to refactor and rewrite several critical components of ERP system for purposes of modernizing technology and increasing software testability, reliability, performance, functionality and user experience. Projects include custom in house Material Requirements Planning, tool for defining manufacturing process for fabricated parts, and tool for defining build schedule for rockets.

• Continual automation improvements through Material Requirements Planning enhancements: added ability to plan for part substitutes which was projected to save over $10 million, added ability to plan for imperfect yields which reduced costly expedites, added ability to plan using reorder point levers for parts with uncertain demand reducing part shortages and expedites, added ability to plan using different bills of material for different use cases such as refurbishment of rockets.

• Automated identification and cancellation of stagnant work orders which led to a significant reduction in unneeded planned order signals sent to material planners to purchase/buy parts.

• Developed application to edit directed acyclic graphs that define sequential and parallel work sequencing through a work order using the yFiles library.

• Continually monitor, triage, and alleviate application performance problems using a mixture of profiling tools: System Center Operations Manager, ANTS Profiler, SQL Server Profiler, & Chrome Developer Tools.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of 4 developers on a group of applications to facilitate internal processes for organizing and tracking of hard drive integrity testing.

• Performed maintenance and new development on critical factory ingrained internal web application that manages 20,000+ matrices of hard drive feature configurations, each of which contains thousands of values.

• Developed web application to bulk edit matrices of data utilizing Ember.js which saves users hours of time for edits spanning multiple matrices.  Bulk editing is done by projecting 3 dimensional spreadsheets into two dimensions and editing columns of values simultaneously in this projected view.  RESTful API developed using Web API for feeding data to front end.

• Worked on the full web stack (front end development, application logic, web services, and database schema/query design).

• Maintained Subversion commit hooks utilizing Python to manage company commit processes including hooks for pre-commit, post-commit, pre-revprop and post-revprop.

positions.title: Student Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
• Worked in a small team to manage department websites and applications running on Microsoft IIS using Visual Studio.

• Designed, implemented and maintained Windows and web applications to meet client specifications such as inventories for chemicals, hazardous waste manifests, and parking structure space availability.

• Created multithreaded application to update parking structure space availability.

• Trained students in the use of ASP.NET / C# to create interactive web applications.
